scenes.text: Identify good manners and why communities value them.
Good manners include greeting people, speaking courteously, being honest, respecting others and showing tolerance. They make relationships peaceful and help people feel welcome.
Societal values also encourage responsibility, hard work and patriotism. We can practise good manners every day with both friends and strangers.
Make a class good-manners chart and role-play greeting, apologising and thanking.
